name: Roxo-paper OEP (purchase, combat move, non-combat move)
description: Online Evolutionary Planning as Roxo's thesis adapts it to TripleA, on the oep_paper framework: one gene per territory (or unit rule) in random order with Roxo's pruned options (combat: getUnitsUpToStrengthSet above 1.1x; non-combat: none/half/all per source territory; purchase: all/half/none per rule), population 50, survival 0.5, mutation 0.1, 10-round Weak AI playouts rated with Roxo's reward, deterministic Fast AI battles.
